brief: Goldman's Prime Services weekly flow report covers November 13-19, 2026. GS Equity Fundamental long/short funds fell 1.59% versus a 5.24% drop in MSCI World, as a 2.43% beta drag was partly offset by 0.84% of alpha from gains on both the short and long sides. Systematic long/short funds were flat, as negative alpha from long losses offset roughly equal positive beta. Overall book gross leverage rose 3.8 points to 315.9% (89th percentile) while net leverage fell 1.3 points to 70.1% and the long/short ratio fell to 1.570 (2nd percentile), as funds added shorts while cutting net long exposure. Global equities were net sold for a 3rd straight week, as gross trading activity rose at the fastest pace in 2.5 months, the largest week of shorting since April 2025, shorts outpacing longs 1.5 to 1. All regions were net sold, led by EM Asia and Europe. Single stocks were net sold a 10th straight week while macro products were bought a 5th. Ten of eleven sectors were net sold. Financials led selling for a 7th straight week at the fastest pace in 8 months, shorts outpacing longs 4.5 to 1, leaving the Prime book underweight Financials by 4.3% versus MSCI World.
